title: check warns of two tasks as unordered when one's story depends on the other's story
goal: unordered_overlap_warnings (ST-xd5vboit) skips a pair when an ancestor of either item is in the other's dependencies, as readiness already orders them; and test_check_warns_unordered_shared_touches asserts exit 0 for either print order (its `code == 0 and A in out or B in out` binds as `(code == 0 and A) or B`). Found by the SP-3rzxx3m4 review.

run: import sys,types;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_plan as p;I={'SP':{'kind':'sprint','status':'active'},'SA':{'kind':'story','status':'doing','sprint':'SP'},'SB':{'kind':'story','status':'todo','sprint':'SP','depends_on':['SA']},'TA':{'kind':'task','status':'todo','parent':'SA','touches':['x.py']},'TB':{'kind':'task','status':'todo','parent':'SB','touches':['x.py']}};par=lambda i:[I[i]['parent']] if 'parent' in I[i] else [];bl=types.SimpleNamespace(items=I,root='.',ancestors=par,label=lambda i:i,sprint_items=lambda s:[i for i in I if I[i]['kind']!='sprint']);sys.exit(1 if any('TA' in w and 'TB' in w for w in p.unordered_overlap_warnings(bl)) else 0)
